Dupatta and hairdo styles

Tap a style to see a real example and what it suits. Decide before your trial if you can — it makes the trial much more useful.

Classic Drape

Dupatta pinned over a bun or sleek hair, framing the face. Your tikka and jewellery stay visible, and the dupatta does not move — through photos, hugs and the rukhsati.

Suits: Barat and Nikkah

  • Best with heavy dupattas — it is pinned in 4–5 places
  • Hair underneath is kept simple, so nothing pokes through
  • Takes about 20 minutes after makeup and hair

First, a trial. Then the day itself.

Most problems on a wedding day come from guessing. A trial removes the guesswork.

Bridal trial — from PKR 8,000

A full session on a normal day, not a quick test. Roughly one hour.

  1. Full makeup in HD or airbrush — your choice
  2. Hairdo and dupatta setting done properly, not pinned roughly
  3. Photos in studio light and near the window, so you see both
  4. Changes on the spot — lip shade, lashes, drape, anything

The trial fee is adjusted when you book the Barat package with us. Ask when you call.

Inside the studio

We are in Johar Town, Lahore. Brides get a separate, quieter area on event days so you are not sitting in the middle of regular appointments.

Regular services — haircuts, colour, facials, nails — run on the main floor. If you are coming for a regular appointment, you can usually get a same-day slot. Bridal dates are different: in wedding season they go 2–3 months ahead.

Questions brides usually ask

How do I book the package I built?

Call 042 35170702 and tell us your event, makeup type and add-ons. We check the date, confirm the final price, and book it with a deposit.

Should I do a trial first?

For Barat and Walima, yes — we strongly recommend it. The trial is from PKR 8,000, takes about an hour, and the fee is adjusted if you book the Barat package with us.

How does the two-events offer work?

Book any two events on one call and the pre-bridal spa mani-pedi is free. Most brides use it for Mehndi + Barat, or Barat + Walima.

How early should I book? What if I need to change the date?

Book 2–3 months ahead in wedding season — dates are given on a first-deposit basis. For regular appointments, please give 24 hours’ notice to reschedule. Bridal deposit terms are explained on the booking call.

Visit us in Johar Town

Booking is by phone only, so we can check your date and artist properly. This number is a landline — please call, do not WhatsApp. Call for directions and today’s timings.
